lesson.subtitle: Lesson 1 -- The Life I've Had
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ana Claudia Veraldi | Lesson 1 -- The Life I've Had

listenings.text: I have lived in four different cities, and honestly, the last move was the one that changed everything. I grew up in a big place, full of traffic and rush hour and noise. For years I told myself that the pace of life was normal. Then one winter I got completely fed up with the commute. Two hours in the morning, two hours at night. So we sold the apartment and moved to a small town near the mountains. That was six years ago. I have never regretted it, not for a single day. My neighbours know my name. I can hear birds instead of car horns. People ask me if I miss the city, and the honest answer is no. I miss some restaurants. I do not miss the life.

Hello Ana, this is Daan. Sorry I could not join the call this morning. I wanted to say it was really nice to meet you last week. You asked me where I grew up, and I did not answer properly, so here it is. I grew up in a very small village, about three thousand people, in the north of the country. I moved to the city when I was nineteen, for university, and I stayed there for almost fifteen years. Two years ago my wife and I moved back to the countryside. Everybody told us we would be bored. We have not been bored once. Talk soon.
